{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party has continued to fulfill America's obligations to its veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many programs designed to assist veterans cried out for modernization and reform when President Bush took office.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and Congress have increased funding for VA health care by more than 40 percent since 2001.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Increased funding has made it possible for the VA to improve health care access for veterans who need it most, including low-income veterans, those with service-related disabilities, and those who need VA's specialized services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush signed into law authorization for the concurrent receipt of both military retired pay and VA disability compensation for combat-injured and highly-disabled veterans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for actions to keep faith with America's veterans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Appreciation for President Bush and the Republican Congress for attending to the solemn duty of maintaining and expanding national cemeteries.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
